mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments ( user_id, comment_content, target_id, target_type, parent_comment_id ) VALUES ( #{user_id}, #{comment_content}, #{targetId}, #{targetType}, #{parent_comment_id} )
mapper.select: SELECT comment_id, user_id, CASE WHEN is_deleted = 1 THEN '[삭제된 댓글입니다.]' ELSE comment_content END AS comment_content, target_id AS targetId, target_type AS targetType, parent_comment_id, created_at, is_deleted FROM comments WHERE target_id = #{targetId} AND target_type = #{targetType} ORDER BY (parent_comment_id IS NULL) DESC, IFNULL(parent_comment_id, comment_id), created_at ASC
SELECT comment_id, user_id, comment_content, target_id AS targetId, target_type AS targetType, parent_comment_id, created_at FROM comments WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET comment_content = #{comment_content}, modified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE comment_id = #{comment_id}
UPDATE comments SET is_deleted = 1, modified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
